exec_rules.condition_action: Planner component/control mode를 그대로 copy한다.
`execution_required`를 code 필요성 전에 판정한다.
exec_rules.verification_failure_enforcement: Prompt/Skill-only인데 executable 생성 → BLOCK; trace checker.

exec_rules.condition_action: 기존 Script/CLI/SDK/Tool/MCP/stdlib를 먼저 inventory한다.
exec_rules.example_counterexample: existing `validate.py` reuse / 같은 API용 MCP 재생성

exec_rules.condition_action: 새 artifact는 deterministic/repeated/objective/adapter/recovery need가 있을 때만 만든다.
exec_rules.example_counterexample: CSV validator / 단발성 메일 문장 수정

exec_rules.condition_action: artifact마다 한 primary responsibility를 둔다.
exec_rules.verification_failure_enforcement: multi-purpose hidden write or undefined effect → BLOCK.

exec_rules.condition_action: runtime/language는 repo/build/deploy fact로 고른다.
exec_rules.example_counterexample: Java service adapter / 취향으로 Python sidecar

exec_rules.condition_action: deterministic contract를 implementation보다 먼저 확정한다.
input is closed, versioned, bounded, and canonicalized where hashed.
stdout has one structured result; diagnostics go elsewhere.
exec_rules.example_counterexample: one JSON result / logs mixed with JSON

exec_rules.condition_action: exit 0 means result emitted, not PASS.
exec_rules.verification_failure_enforcement: output status/Gate result must be separately verified.

exec_rules.condition_action: LLM only proposes semantic candidates; code verifies objective facts.
exec_rules.example_counterexample: LLM maps field / validator validates date

exec_rules.condition_action: shell calls use explicit argv, fixed executable, cwd/env allowlist.
SQL values bind, identifiers allowlist, DB boundary explicit.
external write needs typed effect class and pre-effect Gate result.
dry-run exercises same checks, never writer.
exec_rules.verification_failure_enforcement: dry-run has side effect or lacks target fingerprint → FAIL.

exec_rules.condition_action: apply rechecks plan/Gate/target state.
exec_rules.example_counterexample: new ETag requires replan / reuse old dry run

exec_rules.condition_action: write idempotency key binds exact semantic payload.
exec_rules.verification_failure_enforcement: same key/different digest or cross-tenant reuse → BLOCK.
exec_rules.example_counterexample: stable operation key / timestamp key each retry

exec_rules.condition_action: retry classification is bounded and policy-owned.
uncertain effect is `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`.
exec_rules.example_counterexample: timeout after dispatch / treating timeout as failed

exec_rules.condition_action: reconciliation reads source of truth and emits its own result.
exec_rules.example_counterexample: operation lookup / tool success text only

exec_rules.condition_action: compensation is registered before reversible multi-step effect.
exec_rules.verification_failure_enforcement: no handler/manual repair path → high-risk BLOCK.
exec_rules.example_counterexample: reservation cancel / invent rollback after crash

exec_rules.condition_action: Gate binding includes Plan/Gate/checker/source/lock/input/runtime digests.
every entrypoint has forward and reverse trace.
exec_rules.example_counterexample: Docker entrypoint in inventory / hidden shell task

exec_rules.condition_action: runtime high-risk controls must be actually verified.
deny-first least privilege separates read/write/reconcile/release.
exec_rules.example_counterexample: scoped role / Tool listing equals permission

exec_rules.condition_action: secrets are references only and never LLM context/log/build args.
dependencies/toolchain/image are immutable and auditable.
test evidence binds tested artifact, command, runner/env, result and self-digest.
exec_rules.verification_failure_enforcement: historical `/tmp` evidence or unbound result → no PASS.

exec_rules.condition_action: critical negative mutation and independent audit are required.
exec_rules.example_counterexample: remove Gate ID caught / generator grades itself

exec_rules.condition_action: unimplemented runtime/write/deploy/state/RAG is named unavailable.

exec_invariants.statement: 모든 new artifact에 reuse search evidence가 있다
error text만으로 control flow를 결정하지 않는다
required Gate IDs가 contract catalog에 있다
raw shell/SQL string injection route가 없다
secret value field/CLI/build arg/log evidence가 없다
high-risk sandbox claims have verified inventory
unverified sandbox/runtime means unavailable, not pass
floating dependency or image tag-only is rejected
SBOM/provenance is bound to artifact when policy requires it
historical evidence cannot approve changed subject
every known entrypoint reverse maps to artifact/Gate
post-action-only control cannot satisfy irreversible pre-effect Gate
independent audit input order/identity/evidence is present; absent high-assurance independence blocks final approval
